comment: Config-file semantics both implementations must share. These are the rules v1.7.1 was cut for: a write must never clobber unrelated keys; a file that exists but cannot be decoded is refused, byte-for-byte untouched; a missing file is created; out-of-range values clamp at the write side. 'existing' is a JSON object to pre-write; 'existing_raw' is a literal string (for undecodable inputs); no existing key = the file does not exist.

cases.name: a notify write keeps every unrelated key
an undecodable file is refused and left byte-for-byte intact
a missing file is created rather than treated as corrupt
the write path clamps, not just the read path
switching to a profile that does not exist fails without touching the file
